facts.fact: The World Bank says the Niger government, with its support, used satellite early-warning data to identify drought-affected areas and trigger emergency transfers after the 2021 rainy season.
facts.system: Niger adaptive social protection drought trigger

facts.fact: The World Bank says more than 100,000 Niger families received monthly emergency transfers once the satellite-based drought response was activated.
facts.system: Niger adaptive social protection drought trigger

NER.note: Transfers named, but nothing says they were paid digitally.
